themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: This theme covers AI agents designed to perform research tasks autonomously or with minimal human intervention, including agents for data analysis, discovery, and execution of research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI tools and research that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, including discussions on security vulnerabilities and effectiveness.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: This theme encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms and tools specifically designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis and synthesis.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: This theme covers AI chatbots and conversational agents used to interact with users, gather information, provide support, or conduct research dialogues.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: This theme explores the intersection of AI with user experience (UX) and product design, focusing on AI's role in informing design decisions and enhancing the research process.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: This theme covers AI tools and techniques used to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, aiding in efficient information processing.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: This theme focuses on reviews, comparisons, and analyses of various AI tools, assessing their performance, usability, and effectiveness for specific tasks.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: This theme examines the effects of AI on employment, job displacement, skill requirements, and the evolving nature of work across different industries.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: This theme focuses on AI's application in hiring processes, including AI tools for candidate sourcing, screening, bias detection, and assessing AI skills.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: This theme covers the creation and use of artificial or simulated users for testing and research purposes, including discussions on synthetic data and focus groups.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
